A mailto link is extracted into metadata.links when extract_metadata is true

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper().setPropertyNamingStrategy(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.PropertyNamingStrategies.SNAKE_CASE)
    val options = mapper.readValue("{\"extract_metadata\":true}", ConversionOptions::class.java)
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<p>Contact <a href=\"mailto:hello@example.com\">us</a> directly.</p>", options)
    println(result.content)
    println(result.metadata.links)
}
```
